title: Equality transport of a single derived pushforward unit
statement: Fix schemes A,B,C,D and derived-category instances [def-pc-derived-category]. Let s:A→B, t:B→D, q:A→C, r:C→D and h:s≫t=q≫r. Construct the ordinary comparison e from pushforwardComp(s,t), pushforwardCongr(h), and inverse pushforwardComp(q,r). Use the scheme derived direct images of [def-pc-derived-direct-image] and their defining right-derived units. For each homotopy complex K of module sheaves on A, the single right-derived unit for s≫t followed by equality transport of the derived direct image is the localization of e on homotopy complexes followed by the single right-derived unit for q≫r. Composite direct-image functors are identified by their definitional composition equality. No pullback adjunctions or composition mates occur. The full equation is lean.statement.

source.place: Tags 08HY and 0D5T, ordinary pushforward-composition normalization and equality transport of a single derived unit

proof.text: The pushforward composition isomorphisms are identity maps on sections over every open, by the Mathlib component formulas. They identify degreewise pushforward by two successive morphisms with pushforward by their composite, and hence give the same identification on homotopy complexes.

Use the sectionwise identity formulas to identify pushforwardComp with the equality maps for the definitionally equal direct-image functors; their degreewise identity maps descend to identities under HomotopyCategory.quotient. The square comparison is then equality transport along h. Apply eqToHom_naturality to the family of right-derived units indexed by the composite scheme morphism. Its source equality map is Qh applied to the homotopy equality map, since functors preserve eqToHom. Additive structures are propositions, so their transports agree by proof irrelevance. Substitution gives exactly the displayed equality, for arbitrary complexes including zero and empty-scheme cases, without cancelling any unit.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08HY and 0D5T, elementary normalization of the ordinary square before pasting composition mates

from.place: Equality-transport step of the derived sheaf square mate unit equation

lean.statement:
theorem directImageSquare_unit_transport {A B C D : Scheme.{u}}
    (s : A ⟶ B) (t : B ⟶ D) (q : A ⟶ C) (r : C ⟶ D) (h : s ≫ t = q ≫ r)
    (K : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings A.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ)) :
    (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (s ≫ t).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K ≫
        (eqToHom (congrArg (fun v ↦ schemeDerivedDirectImage.{u, w} v) h)).app
          (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) =
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map
          (((directImageSquareIso s t q r h).hom.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).app K) ≫
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (q ≫ r).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K
